text:
Sam Park: Quick question — Zenith asked for our preferred reserve-commit granularity and what inputs they should provide for the marketplace cost model. Need a short checklist we can send today.
Jia Chen: Short answer: SKU id, region, commit tenor (months), reserved quantity (vCPU/GPU hours), typical eviction profile for spot, and a price floor / list price. Also % of capacity marked as burstable.
Luis Ortega: Adding: we need sample daily availability curve (csv) or a small timeseries, and an example of how they report preempt events (timestamp + duration). Our cost model ingests daily buckets.
Cassie Park (Finance): For pricing we need
- reserved unit price (USD/hr)
- spot price or discount % vs reserved
- any volume tier discounts (thresholds + %)
- refund/credit policy on evictions
I can map to P&L once we have those.
Sam Park: Perfect. Can someone draft a one-paragraph ask and a CSV template we can paste to vendors? I can send from partnerships@redwood.
Luis Ortega: I'll drop a tiny CSV snippet. Vendors prefer example rows.

Vendor Integration Bot: Uploading sample CSV rows now.
```
sku_id,region,date,available_hours,reserved_capacity_hours,spot_capacity_hours,evictions_count,avg_spot_price_usd
zenith-gpu-a100,us-west-2,2026-03-01,24,480,3600,2,0.75
zenith-gpu-a100,us-west-2,2026-03-02,24,480,3520,1,0.72
```

Jia Chen: That looks good. Also include a separate small table for commitment terms, e.g.
```
sku_id,commit_tenor_months,reserved_hourly_usd,volume_tier_1_threshold,volume_tier_1_discount
zenith-gpu-a100,12,2.50,10000,0.07
```
Ryan (Sales): Vendors always ask about billing lag/credit timing. Add field: "credit_latency_days" so they tell us expected delay to refund credits after eviction.
Cassie Park (Finance): +1 on credit_latency_days. Also ask them to confirm tax/VAT handling and whether fees are listed gross.
Sam Park: Drafted a short message below — feel free to edit before I send.

Sam Park: "Hey Zenith ops team — quick onboarding ask from Redwood: please share the following in CSV or small sample files so we can plug into our marketplace cost model: SKU identifiers, per-region daily availability (date + available hours), reserved vs spot capacity counts, observed eviction events (timestamps) and avg spot prices, commitment offers (tenor, reserved hourly price, volume tiers and discounts), credit/refund policy (including credit latency days), and any regional taxes or platform fees. Example CSV rows attached. If you can give a 14-day sample and your standard commit offering, that'd let us run a first-pass cost model. Thanks! — Sam"

Jia Chen: Add: ask for typical sequence length / instance footprint (e.g., tokens per call or concurrent connections) if available — helps with throughput mapping.
Luis Ortega: Also ask whether they allow short-term bursts outside the reserved bucket and how those are billed (flat rate vs premium).
Cassie Park (Finance): Deadline? We need inputs by EOD Friday to hit next week's pricing sync.
Sam Park: I'll send in 30m and cc Cassie + Eng cost modeling. Tagging @Jia to attach the CSV template in the vendor email thread.
Ryan (Sales): I can offer a follow-up call if they prefer to walk through the CSV.
Vendor Integration Bot: Note: vendor file upload received: zenith-sample-availability.csv (2 rows)
Sam Park: Thanks all. Action items:
- Jia: attach CSV template to email
- Luis: include small sample rows and a note on eviction schema
- Cassie: prepare mapping doc for finance fields
- Ryan: offer follow-up call
Target send: today by 11:30am PT. :thumbsup:
